title: Add a product-owned OpenRouter extraction adapter
objective: Residual extraction can call an exact provider/model through a small typed interface.
outcome: Offline fixtures cover missing credentials, unsupported structured outputs and a missing exact model; none falls back silently. Malformed JSON, truncated output, provider error and schema-valid but unsupported fields are rejected without publishing claims. A fake-provider end-to-end residual job passes without a harness installation. No model is imported into the public Worker request path. Paid calls remain disabled until budget/key are provisioned. Provider transport success is not claim acceptance.

commits.subject: Define the provider request contract
commits.instructions: Add model/endpoint identity, prompt hash, evidence IDs, JSON response schema, token limits and timeout. Keep provider credentials behind an injected secret port.
commits.verification: Offline fixtures cover missing credentials, unsupported structured outputs and a missing exact model; none falls back silently.

commits.subject: Implement the bounded OpenRouter client
commits.instructions: Use the official API through an injected transport; require supported parameters and validate the returned JSON locally. Retain response/model/usage identifiers and typed errors.
commits.verification: Malformed JSON, truncated output, provider error and schema-valid but unsupported fields are rejected without publishing claims.

commits.subject: Replace the extraction shell dependency
commits.instructions: Connect the residual-job port to the adapter instead of launching dsh for product enrichment. Keep external coding implementers separate from this runtime.
commits.verification: A fake-provider end-to-end job passes without a harness installation; no model is imported into the public Worker request path.
